# Discussion categories to create

GitHub creates Discussion categories from the repository settings (Settings → General → Features → Discussions, then
the ✏️ on the Discussions page). Suggested set — the slugs must match the templates in `DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/`:

| Category | Slug | Format | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 📣 Announcements | `announcements` | Announcement (maintainers post) | New API versions, releases, the catalog |
| 🙏 Q&A | `q-a` | Question / Answer | Help building plugins |
| 💡 Ideas | `ideas` | Open-ended | Plugin ideas and API requests before they become issues |
| 🧩 Show your plugin | `show-your-plugin` | Open-ended | Share plugins; source for the future community catalog |
| 💬 General | `general` | Open-ended | Everything else |

This file is only a note for the maintainers; it can be deleted once the categories exist.
